name: Railway Recruitment Boards - Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) Examination

conducting_body.name: Railway Recruitment Control Board / Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs), Ministry of Railways
conducting_body.headquarters: Rail Bhavan, Raisina Road, New Delhi 110001

official_sources.name: Railway Recruitment Boards Centralized Application Portal (RRB Apply)
Centralised Employment Notice (CEN) for Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) 2026
Official Railway Recruitment Boards ALP Historical Question Papers Corpus (2018-2025)

cbt_1.nature: First Stage CBT (Screening / Qualifying for CBT-2)

sections.name: Mental Ability / General Intelligence and Reasoning
General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences up to 10th standard)

part_a.nature: Merit Determining Stage (Carries 70% weightage in final merit calculation)

sections.name: Basic Science and Engineering (Engineering Drawing, Units, Mechanics, Electricity)

part_b.nature: Qualifying Trade Test (Mandatory 35% pass mark per DGET syllabus)

sections.name: Relevant Trade Technical Test (Electrician / Fitter / Diesel Mechanic / Electronics)

subsequent_stages.cbat: Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT) - 5 Test Batteries, T-score 42 minimum in each battery with no relaxation, 30% weightage in final merit
subsequent_stages.medical_standard: Strict A-1 Medical Standard (Distant vision 6/6, 6/6 without glasses with fogging test; Near vision Sn 0.6, 0.6 without glasses; Color/Binocular/Field/Night vision tests pass mandatory)

posts_and_pay_scales.pay_level: Level 2 (₹19,900 initial pay plus running allowances)
posts_and_pay_scales.minimum_qualification: Matriculation / SSLC plus ITI / Act Apprenticeship in specified trades OR Diploma / Degree in Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics / Automobile Engineering

eligibility_criteria.age_limit: 18 to 33 years (Age relaxation: OBC +3 years, SC/ST +5 years)
eligibility_criteria.educational_qualification: Matriculation / 10th Standard Pass PLUS ITI in approved trade (Fitter, Electrician, Wireman, Mechanic Diesel, Machinist, etc.) OR 3-year Diploma in Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics / Automobile Engineering OR B.Tech / B.E. in relevant engineering branches.
eligibility_criteria.medical_fitness: Must fulfill A-1 Medical Standard strictly. Candidates with LASIK surgery or defective color vision are strictly ineligible.
